params.name: startTimestampAfter
params.description: ISO 8601: only alerts sent after this time.

params.name: alertRecipientIds
params.description: Filter to alerts sent to specific recipient IDs.

params.name: includeMuted
params.description: Include muted alerts that were not sent to users. Defaults to false.

params.name: nextPageCursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response's pagination.nextPageCursor to fetch the next page. Keep all other parameters identical.

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of alerts (low battery, charging completed, charging session error, offline charger, late charging).
